cohort: 104 pregnant women with cardiac disease (including 3 with Eisenmenger Syndrome) out of 27,259 antenatal women who delivered over a 1-year period at a tertiary teaching institute.
finding: Of the three cases of Eisenmenger Syndrome in pregnancy, there were no maternal deaths, but one fetal demise occurred, all deliveries were preterm, and two-thirds were vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was conducted in 66.7% while 33.3% had a cesarean delivery.
